stock.description: BoardWare Intelligence Technology Limited, established in Macau in 2010, specializes in delivering sophisticated enterprise IT solutions. The company provides a comprehensive suite of professional IT services, including crucial aspects like data networking, robust system infrastructure deployment, virtualization technologies, and extensive cybersecurity protection. Additionally, it offers IT operation management services, encompassing secure cloud solutions, continuous monitoring of clients' cybersecurity environments, and maintaining uninterrupted system and network connectivity. BoardWare also furnishes vital maintenance support for various IT systems and applications. Beyond technical services, the firm provides expert IT consultancy and advisory, often involving on-site evaluations of customer premises to assess their IT operational landscape and ensure adherence to governmental compliance standards. The company also operates in Hong Kong and Macau as a distributor and reseller of hardware, such as laptops, and diverse software products, including Windows operating system licenses and third-party applications. Its clientele spans a wide array of industries, including telecommunications, media, technology, gaming, hospitality, and public sectors.
